_source: World population, rounded. Our World in Data (based on HYDE 3.2 and UN World Population Prospects 2024); the billion milestones (1927, 1960, 1974, 1987, 1999, 2011, 2022) are UN figures. Ancient values are uncertain by up to a factor of two: estimates for 1 CE range from about 170 to 300 million.
